svg.font-family: Fragment Mono, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace
svg.title: Mail reaches a busy agent at its next tool call
svg.desc: A timeline of bob@shop's session: a tool call, then alice@shop's mail arrives while bob is mid-task, then bob's next tool call, after which the post-tool hook adds a one-line notice naming the message. An idle Herdr agent is woken by the loopback daemon instead. Each message is announced once.
svg.text: Another: 1 new message(s) for bob@shop (0 urgent): "Review the parser"
from alice@shop (opens request 01J...). Read them with fetch_inbox.
one line from the post-tool hook, into the running session, no interruption
an idle agent makes no tool calls
the loopback daemon wakes an idle Herdr agent; tmux and cmux panes are woken on demand
each message is announced once: mid-task notice, prompt notice or daemon wake, whichever is first
